Lucid Total · mocks v0.2

2026-10-28. An operating system, not a reporting system: the Horizon shows the few things that need you over a world that breathes beneath it; Talk is the shell; the world is a map at every depth, its places have landmarks and rings, its buildings show the products; decisions are forks with their consequences drawn. Every caption names its focal subject, its use cases and its attention counts.

Device

Device · Phone shows the designed phone layout wherever a moment has one (frames 1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 12, 14 and 19, and the phone frames 34–37). The other frames stay desktop on purpose: the phone never shows a shrunk desktop (docs/13 §10).

A · Horizon and the world

Glance and Dive: the Horizon over a world that breathes beneath it, the company as places with landmarks and rings, perspectives, the zoom that reveals, the buildings that show the product, and the board as an instrument.

B · Products

The item is a product view: the product large and first, expected beside actual, the goal and the done rule in one line each, criteria as a ring, the talk, the roads, and the implications first when done.

C · Decisions

Decide mode: a decision is a fork with its consequences drawn and a published confidence per path; strategy as futures with haze; Refocus as effort moved over the world with the transparency strip; the small change; an ask as a small fork.

D · Meetings and daily use

Meet mode and the quick moments: the Table where spoken decisions land on the world, minutes that nobody writes, a status composed from one question, and a scene re-composed on request.

E · Aspects and infographics

Dashboards that are places to think: quiet, trend and shape first, the finding as the headline of every chart, one tap into the places behind a number; infographics as one story on one screen.

F · The system

Lucid Total runs itself: its subsystems as a place, repairs as visible loops with evidence, AI processes as quiet cards with four states, models as classes and decisions, autonomy as a trust layer on the world.

G · Channels

The system where people already are: a verified contact in Lucid Chat, decisions by email reply, a quiet member of Slack channels.

H · Phone

The phone is its own surface: one place or one decision at a time, full-bleed, hold to confirm and hold to talk.

I · Variants and legend

Right to left, high contrast, the list equivalent, and the reference sheet of the mark, the landmarks and the grammar.
